title: Scheduling
description: Plan people and resources by day or hour on configurable boards. Project schedules live on project records.

empty.title: Set up your first board
empty.description: A board is a schedule for one part of your business: a crew booked by the day, a team on shifts, or your project schedules.
empty.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to create a schedule board in Setup.

grid.label: Schedule grid
grid.noPeople: No people or resources are in this board’s scope.
grid.selected: {count} cells selected — type to book them all, Delete to clear, Ctrl+D or Ctrl+R to fill
grid.hint: Click a cell and type a code to book. Drag across cells to book many at once; paste straight from a spreadsheet.
grid.readOnly: You can view this board. Booking needs permission to manage schedules.
grid.noPeopleAsk: Who appears on a board is set in its scope by whoever manages schedule boards. Ask your administrator to add you or your team.

picker.placeholder: Type a code, customer, project or location
picker.none: Nothing matches. Check the code or add the customer, project or schedule code first.
picker.hint: Add /detail or a time range like 6-14:30

history.clear: {count, plural, one {removing a booking} other {removing # bookings}}
history.paste: {count, plural, one {pasting a cell} other {pasting # cells}}
history.discard: {count, plural, one {discarding a change} other {discarding # changes}}

notices.skippedLeave: {count, plural, one {Skipped a day with recorded leave.} other {Skipped # days with recorded leave.}}
notices.skippedLeaveRemedy: Change the leave through its request if the person is working.
notices.copied: {count, plural, one {Copied a cell.} other {Copied # cells.}}
notices.unknownCodes: {count, plural, one {This code was not recognized: {codes}.} other {# codes were not recognized: {codes}.}}
notices.unknownCodesRemedy: Add them as schedule codes, customers or projects, then paste again.
notices.published: {count, plural, one {Published a change.} other {Published # changes.}}

publish.pending: {count, plural, one {# unpublished change} other {# unpublished changes}} for {people, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
publish.explain: Planned bookings; published changes are visible to the team.
publish.submitted: {count, plural, one {Submitted a change for publication.} other {Submitted # changes for publication.}}
publish.governedExplain: Governed board: publishing records a publication. When an approval Flow applies, the changes publish once it is approved.
publish.awaiting: {count, plural, one {# change is} other {# changes are}} waiting for a publication decision.
publish.awaitingFlow: An approval Flow decides this publication in Approvals. The submitted changes stay locked until then.

drawer.title: Booking
drawer.otherBoard: This booking belongs to {board}. Open that board to change it.
drawer.readOnly: You can view this booking. Changing it needs permission to manage schedules.
drawer.draft: This change is not published yet.
drawer.notesPlaceholder: What the crew needs to know
drawer.removalDraft: This draft removes the published booking once its publication is applied.
drawer.awaitingApproval: This change is in a publication waiting for its decision and cannot be edited.
drawer.governed: Published under governed publication. Changes create a new revision that publishes through the next publication.
drawer.closedOn: Closed on {date}. A closed shift cannot change.

openRequest.awaiting_counterpart: A {kind} request is waiting for the colleague's answer.
openRequest.pending: A {kind} request is waiting for approval.

drawer.noAttendance: Attendance has not been observed for this shift yet.
drawer.closeExplain: Closing records the shift's attendance as reviewed. A closed shift cannot change afterwards.

targets.empty: Nothing is booked in these dates yet.
targets.allBooked: Every row is booked or unavailable this day.

tasks.noProjects: No active projects are in this board's scope.

progress.noTasks: This project has no tasks yet. Add them on the Gantt or the project's work breakdown.
progress.explain: Earned hours are percent complete × budget hours. Productivity is earned ÷ actual hours: above 1.00 the work is ahead of budget. Hours to complete assume the pace so far continues. Actual hours count approved time.

newBoard.title: New board
newBoard.description: Pick the way this part of the business schedules. Everything stays adjustable in the board settings.

dispatch.title: Day dispatch
dispatch.description: Send people to a customer, site or job for the day. A two-week grid you type into; changes go out as you make them.

shifts.title: Shift roster
shifts.description: Part-day shifts by the hour, for stores, kitchens and front desks. Build the week, then publish it.

continuous.title: Round-the-clock operations
continuous.description: Day and night shifts that cross midnight, planned four weeks at a time for plants and around-the-clock teams.

projects.title: Project schedule
projects.description: Project tasks on a Gantt with dependencies and the critical path, plus production progress.

resources.title: Equipment and locations
resources.description: Reserve shared equipment units or locations by day or hour across projects.

roster.title: Managed shift roster
roster.description: Recurring shift patterns, employee shift requests, optional approval of publishing and time-clock attendance with late, early and absent badges.

service.title: Service dispatch
service.description: Technician columns on a time axis with the queue of visits to schedule; assignments go live at once.

newBoard.name: Name
newBoard.afterwards: Booking hours, publishing and timesheet pre-fill can be changed in the board settings at any time.

errors.load: The schedule could not be loaded.
errors.save: The change could not be saved.
errors.publish: The board could not be published.
errors.search: The search could not be completed.

prefill.timesheetHint: Add the hours from your published bookings to empty days. Review them, then save.
prefill.crewHint: Add the people booked to this project on this day. Review the hours, then save the lines.
prefill.ticketHint: Add the crew booked to this project in the ticket period. Review the hours, then save.
prefill.nothing: Every scheduled day already has hours.
prefill.filled: {count, plural, one {Filled # day from the schedule.} other {Filled # days from the schedule.}} {skipped, plural, =0 {} one {# day already had hours.} other {# days already had hours.}} Review and save.
prefill.crewFilled: {count, plural, one {Added # person from the schedule.} other {Added # people from the schedule.}} Review the hours and save the lines.
prefill.crewNothing: Everyone booked to this project today is already on the sheet.
prefill.reload: Some scheduled people, tasks or time types changed. Close and reopen this ticket to load the current choices, then fill again.

notify.subject: Your schedule changed — {board}
notify.intro: Hi {name}, {count, plural, one {one day on your schedule changed.} other {# days on your schedule changed.}}
notify.footer: You receive this because {board} notifies people when their schedule changes.
notify.noTransport: Email is not set up, so people were notified in OpenBooks only. Set up email in Admin → Email.
notify.nativeDistribution: Email schedules through a reviewed Schedule distribution Flow.

mine.title: My schedule
mine.description: Where you are booked and when, as published by your schedulers.
mine.summary: {days, plural, one {# day booked} other {# days booked}} · {hours}
mine.empty: Nothing is booked for you from {from} to {through}.

request.title: Request a shift change
request.explain: Your scheduler's approval Flow decides the request when one is configured; otherwise it applies as soon as you send it.
request.changeExplain: Ask for different hours on the same day.
request.swapExplain: Offer to trade with a colleague's shift. The colleague accepts first.
request.releaseExplain: Ask to be taken off this shift.
request.noCandidates: No colleague has a published shift on this board within two weeks to swap with.
request.applied: Your request was applied to the schedule.
request.offered: Your swap offer was sent to {name}.
request.submitted: Your request is waiting for approval.

requests.title: Shift requests
requests.offers: {count, plural, one {A colleague asked to swap shifts with you.} other {# colleagues asked to swap shifts with you.}}

source.explanation: Imported scheduling evidence is read-only. It preserves the source date and instructions without creating worked time, changing employee status, or reserving new availability.
source.unknownHours: Hours were not supplied by the source.
source.hidden: This row was hidden in the original board; its evidence is retained.
source.multiple: The source retained {count} records for this person and date. No record has been assumed to supersede another.
source.label: Source label

boards.description: List, configure and archive scheduling boards.

distribution.title: Email schedule
distribution.refused: Schedule distribution could not be completed.
distribution.explanation: Choose personal reports or a whole-board report for every selected recipient. Published bookings and literal source-date observations are shown separately. Sending uses your enabled Schedule distribution Flow and configured email provider.
distribution.queued: The reviewed schedule is queued for email delivery.
distribution.deliveryStatus: Queued is not delivered. Follow the native Flow run, Email log and delivery audit for actual provider results.
distribution.wholeBoard: The whole visible board schedule for each recipient
distribution.wholeBoardReview: Every selected recipient will receive the whole reviewed board report, including other people/resources. Board Settings must explicitly allow this sharing within the board’s legal entity.

cohorts.scheduled: Current employees scheduled in these dates

distribution.additionalHelp: Optional contacts receive the whole reviewed board report, even when they are not scheduled. Choose visible native contacts and review sharing before sending.
distribution.refineSearch: More contacts match. Refine the search to see the intended contact.
distribution.excludedHistory: {count} historical people are retained in the report but excluded from current employee delivery.
distribution.roleHelp: Optional native application roles resolve their currently active members to visible People contacts at each send. Review the full board sharing before including a group.

editor.invalid: Use at most 4000 characters and safe links.

recurring.explain: Assign a shift pattern to a person to book their shifts automatically. Bookings you change by hand are kept; started shifts are never touched.
recurring.noPatterns: No active shift patterns apply to this board.
recurring.noPatternsRemedy: Add one in Setup → Shift patterns, for this board's legal entity or for every legal entity.
recurring.empty: Nobody on this board has a recurring shift pattern yet.
recurring.generated: Generated through {through}: {created} added, {revised} updated, {removed} removed, {kept} kept as changed by hand.
recurring.endExplain: Choose the first date the pattern no longer books. Its future bookings from that date are removed.
recurring.cancelExplain: The assignment stops and its future bookings are removed. Started and past shifts stay as they are.
recurring.omitExplain: Choose the date the pattern should not book.

requests.explain: Employees ask to release, change or swap their published shifts from My schedule. A configured approval Flow decides them in Approvals; without one they apply when submitted.
requests.noApproval: No approval Flow applied; applied when submitted.

attendance.observeExplain: Compare published shifts from {from} to {through} with the device check-ins received so far.
attendance.summary: {present} present, {absent} absent, {waiting} waiting for a device, {refused} not observed.
attendance.importExplain: Upload a device export as CSV with the columns source_event_id, source_worker_id, kind (clock_in, clock_out, break_start, break_end or void), occurred_at with its UTC offset, and optionally source_version. Every column is kept as evidence.
attendance.noDevices: No active attendance devices are registered for your legal entities.
attendance.noDevicesRemedy: Register one in Setup → Attendance devices and map its worker identifiers.
attendance.completeThroughHelp: The instant up to which the device has sent every check-in, with its offset; the device clock is in {zone}. Leave empty when the export may be partial.
attendance.badWatermark: The completeness time needs a date, a time and a UTC offset.

csv.empty: The file has no check-in rows.
csv.duplicate: Line {line} repeats the event and version on line {first}.
csv.kind: Line {line} has a kind other than clock_in, clock_out, break_start, break_end or void.
csv.time: Line {line} needs occurred_at as a date and time with its UTC offset.
csv.version: Line {line} needs source_version as a whole number of at least 1.
csv.blank: Line {line} has no source_event_id or source_worker_id.
csv.columns: Line {line} has a different number of columns than the header.
csv.remedy: Correct the export and choose the file again; nothing was imported.
